card-1.title: Welder 141 (Process Piping)
card-1.description: Our company is looking for an experienced 141 welder to perform welding tasks on process piping systems of various diameters. We invite candidates who are ready to work with both low-alloy and high-alloy steels and ensure top-level welding quality.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
responsibilities.item1: Welding process pipelines of various diameters made of low-alloy and high-alloy steels.
responsibilities.item2: Performing welding work in compliance with all quality standards and requirements.
responsibilities.item3: Welding pipelines subject to X-ray inspection.
responsibilities.item4: Maintaining a clean work environment and following occupational safety regulations.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.item1: At least 3 years of experience as a 141 welder.
requirements.item2: Knowledge of welding techniques for pipelines of various diameters.
requirements.item3: Ability to work with low-alloy and high-alloy steels.

conditions.title: What we offer?!
conditions.item1: Employment in a stable company with career growth opportunities.
conditions.item2: Excellent working conditions and full compliance with safety standards.

card-2.title: Process Piping Installer
card-2.description: Our company is hiring process piping installers. You will work with drawings and be responsible for the assembly of piping systems. We are looking for a reliable specialist capable of ensuring accuracy and high-quality installation.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
responsibilities.item1: Installing process piping systems according to project documentation.
responsibilities.item3: Installing and connecting pipes, fittings, and shut-off valves.

requirements.title: Candidate Requirements
requirements.item1: At least 3 years of experience as a process piping installer.
requirements.item2: Ability to work with isometric drawings and diagrams.
requirements.item3: Knowledge of safety standards and regulations for piping installation.
requirements.item4: Attention to detail and a sense of responsibility.
requirements.item5: Willingness to travel for business trips.

conditions.title: What we offer?!
conditions.item1: Professional growth and development in a large and stable company.
conditions.item3: Opportunities to participate in high-level and interesting projects.
